strips.title: A day with the REDTIGER F7NP — in real life

panels.head: Dark commute
panels.text: Clocks go back Nov 1; the 5 p.m. drive is now after sunset.

panels.head: Mount and go
panels.text: Mount behind the mirror, plug in, card in: it records on start.

panels.head: Fender bender
panels.text: The G-sensor locks the clip; copy it off the card the same day.

panels.head: Parking, sorted
panels.text: With a hardwire kit the camera keeps watch while you sleep.
